name: falkyria-lumen-docs
description: Geracao da documentacao do Projeto Lumen em .docx

scripts.docs: for f in build_*.js; do node "$f"; done
scripts.diagrams: mkdir -p ../docs/diagramas && cd diagrams && for f in *.mmd; do mmdc -i "$f" -o "../../docs/diagramas/${f%.mmd}.png" -b white -s 2 -c mconf.json -p puppeteer.json --quiet; done
